detail.title: PS5 Slim Vertical Docking Station Stand - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports PS5 Slim Vertical Docking Station is a purpose-built stand for PS5 Slim Disc and Digital editions, holding the console securely upright to save desk space. RGB lighting with a fixed blue mode and adjustable light switch lets you set the mood for different games, with a memory function that remembers your last chosen setting. A bundled safety screw firmly secures the console to the stand for extra stability, preventing accidental knocks or tip-overs, while anti-slip pads on the base add further security. Two extra USB ports let you charge controllers or other PS5 accessories directly from the stand, rounding out a compact, one-minute-install solution for any PS5 Slim setup.
